title: Marcos welcomes leaders as 49th ASEAN Summit opens

blocks.caption: Marcos welcomes leaders as 49th ASEAN Summit opens

blocks.text: Watch the opening ceremony of the 49th ASEAN Summit here

MANILA, Philippines – Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. welcomes leaders from member states of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, during the summit’s opening ceremony at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City on Sunday, November 15.
Watch the opening ceremony here. – Rappler.com
